entries.title: Guest scheduler: one booking link that checks every host's calendar
entries.summary: A **booking link** for speakers, podcast guests and interviewees that checks every host's Google Calendar together, so the guest only sees times when all hosts are free. Guests see times in their own time zone (with a switcher); the default zone for working hours is the first host's calendar zone. A booking puts one event on everyone's calendar with Zoom or Google Meet and **reschedule and cancel links** that work without signing in, and moves the guest's Contact to **Confirmed** in the pipeline. Set it up from Claude, ChatGPT or the API.

where.path: Assistant (MCP) or API: CRM → Guest scheduler

entries.use_case: A team running a show or webinar series with two hosts sends guests one link instead of trading emails; the guest books a time both hosts are free, everyone gets the invite, and the CRM shows the guest as Confirmed.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks for a HubSpot- or Calendly-style booking link for speakers or guests, especially with more than one host.
internal.who_should_get_it: CRM customers who book speakers, podcast or webinar guests with two or more hosts.
internal.gotchas: Each host connects their own Google Calendar (connect_scheduler_calendar) before the link takes bookings. Zoom meetings need meeting scopes on the org's Zoom app; without them the booking still goes through with no Zoom link. A release template is never sent automatically.

draft.why_use_it: Book guests with several hosts without the back-and-forth, and keep the CRM pipeline current automatically.

entries.title: Cvent: any dropdown field can set the session category
entries.summary: A dropdown field you created, not just **Track**, **Format** or **Level**, can now fill a Cvent session's category. Sessionboard sends the Cvent session category with the same name as the selected value, and the sync log names any value that has no matching category in Cvent.

where.path: Apps → Cvent → Event mapping → Map Session Fields → category

entries.use_case: If you sort sessions in Cvent by your own Session Format or Type field, map it to category and Cvent gets each session's category automatically, so nobody has to set it by hand in Cvent.

cs_action.note: Tell customers who map a custom dropdown to Cvent category (ACA, SB-11586) to add each dropdown value as a session category in Cvent, then re-sync.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a Cvent customer says Category stays blank in Cvent even though they mapped a field to it.
internal.who_should_get_it: Cvent customers who map one of their own dropdown fields to Cvent's category.
internal.staff_path: Event → Apps → Cvent → Event mapping → Map Session Fields
internal.gotchas: Sessionboard never creates session categories in Cvent. A value with no matching category leaves Category unset, and the sync log shows a [CATEGORY] warning naming it. Before this fix, a custom dropdown mapped to category was dropped with no error.

entries.title: Clip export works on recordings with long transcript lines
entries.summary: Exporting a suggested clip no longer fails with **Request failed** when the lines it covers are long. A clip exports even when a transcript line runs to thousands of characters.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording → Edit & clip → Export

entries.use_case: Teams that cut clips from long talks with few pauses can export every suggested clip instead of hitting an error on some of them.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says clip export shows a red Request failed toast on some clips but not others.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who cut clips from long uploaded recordings, especially audio.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: The per-line limit for a clip export went from 1,000 to 50,000 characters; a clip can still carry up to 200 text edits.

entries.title: A blocked YouTube import offers Upload the file instead
entries.summary: When a link import can't download the video (YouTube blocked the download, or the video is private, removed or blocked in your region), the failed item says why in plain words and offers **Upload the file instead**. The upload goes to the same event and replaces the failed item.

where.path: Marketing → Media → Import → Import from a URL

entries.use_case: A failed YouTube import used to be a dead end. Now the customer sees why and gets the recording in with one click, without leaving a broken item in the Library.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says a YouTube import failed or is stuck.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who import recordings from YouTube or Vimeo links.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: YouTube still blocks some automated downloads; the fix is the clear message and the one-click upload, not a guarantee that every link imports.

entries.title: Clip copilot works on long recordings, with up to 100 clips
entries.summary: The clip copilot in the Create clip editor no longer errors on long recordings, and **Apply** saves its changes. A recording can now hold up to 100 clip suggestions.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording → Edit & clip → Copilot

entries.use_case: Hour-long keynotes and panels are where the copilot saves the most time, and that is where it used to fail. It now works on them.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says the clip copilot errors or Apply does nothing on a long recording.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who use the clip copilot on recordings longer than about 45 minutes.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: Before the fix the copilot failed once a recording had more than 20 suggested clips, which happens at roughly 50 minutes.

entries.title: Edit transcript lines up to 50,000 characters
entries.summary: You can edit and save a transcript line of up to 50,000 characters. Long lines used to be cut off at 5,000 characters in the editor.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording → Transcript → pencil on a line

entries.use_case: Customers can correct any line in an older or long transcript, not just the short ones.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says they can't type into or save a long transcript line.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who correct transcripts by hand, especially recordings transcribed before sentence-aware lines.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording

entries.title: Transcript lines end at sentences
entries.summary: New uploads and sessions captured with Live Transcribe get transcript lines that end at the end of a sentence and run to a short paragraph each, instead of breaking mid-sentence or running on for pages.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording → Transcript

entries.use_case: Transcripts read like paragraphs, so quotes, edits and captions start and stop where the speaker's thought does.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says transcript lines break mid-sentence or one line is enormous.
internal.who_should_get_it: Every customer who transcribes recordings or live sessions.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: Applies to new transcriptions. Existing transcripts change only where the backfill script has been run; lines a person edited are never re-cut.

entries.title: Transcript search, pinned player, and select to quote or clip
entries.summary: Transcript search shows **N of M** matches and jumps between them with Enter, Shift+Enter or the arrows, and it finds phrases across line breaks. The player stays pinned while you scroll. Select words to **Add to Quotes** or **Make clip**, or use each line's quote and clip buttons from the keyboard.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording or captured session → Transcript

entries.use_case: A content team can find a phrase in a 90-minute talk, keep listening while they read, and save the line as a quote or clip in one step.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks how to pull a specific quote or clip from a long transcript.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who use Media, Live Transcribe or Quotes to repurpose sessions.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: Make clip needs a recording that can be cut; if the video is still processing the quote is saved and the message says the clip could not be made yet.

entries.title: Captured sessions get chapters, clips, quotes and Create
entries.summary: A session captured with Live Transcribe now has the same actions as an uploaded recording: **Generate chapters**, **Find share-worthy clips**, **Find quotes**, **Edit clip in Create**, **Export audiogram** and **Export transcript**. No need to download the audio and upload it again.

where.path: Marketing → Transcribe → Captured sessions → open a session → Actions

entries.use_case: Sessions captured live turn into clips and quotes the same day, without the download and re-upload customers were doing.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer captures sessions with Live Transcribe and asks how to make clips or quotes from them.
internal.gotchas: Edit clip in Create and Export audiogram need the session's saved audio and are hidden when there is none; chapters and quotes still work.

entries.title: Speaker tags carry to quotes, clip picks and Notable Phrases
entries.summary: When you tag, re-tag or clear a speaker, their quotes and clip suggestions take the new name and are linked to the speaker's contact, and **Notable Phrases** name the tagged speaker instead of Speaker 1. Quotes you save are linked to the tagged contact too.

where.path: Marketing → Media → open a recording → Speakers in this recording → Tag

entries.use_case: Quotes and clips are attributed to the right person without fixing each one by hand, which is what makes a speaker's content show up on their profile.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer says quotes or Notable Phrases still say Speaker N after they tagged everyone.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers who tag speakers on recordings or captured sessions.
internal.staff_path: Event → Marketing → Media → open a recording
internal.gotchas: Quotes pulled before this change update the next time the speaker's tag changes, or once the quote-contact backfill has run in that region. A speaker name typed into a quote by hand is never overwritten.

entries.title: Content on the contact profile: speaking time, quotes and clips
entries.summary: A contact's **Marketing** tab has a **Content** section: the sessions and recordings they spoke in with their speaking time, their top quotes and their clips. The tab now also shows for organizations with Transcribe, Quotes or Clips.

where.path: Contacts → open a contact → Marketing → Content

entries.use_case: Before a speaker's next event, a content team can see in one place what they said, for how long, and which quotes and clips came out of it.

cs_action.note: AFIS reported this (HubSpot ticket 51146426723, SB-11568 to SB-11579). Tell them the batch is live and ask them to retry.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks where to see a speaker's quotes or speaking time.
internal.who_should_get_it: Customers with Marketing Transcribe, Quotes or Clips who tag speakers.
internal.staff_path: Event → Contacts → open a contact → Marketing
internal.gotchas: Speaking time and quotes only count once the voice is tagged as that contact.
